name: Shinjou Saria
source:
A rival.
The daughter of the Shinjou group, a wealthy and influential conglomerate. Haughty, arrogant and looks down on almost everyone as being beneath her. Carries a grudge against Aoi for stealing the title of Miss Mikage from her.
